summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Arrow Valtoro ETF (ORO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed but uses an index as a guide to tactically allocate between Bitcoin, gold, and Treasury futures contracts. The ETF seeks to provide growth with reduced volatility. ORO was launched on Oct 17, 2025 and is issued by Arrow Funds.
